description: A complete, machine-admitted Smithian Fold Theory foundation for Social and Collective Sciences: 72 zero-parameter laws, 18,432 exhaustively enumerated forms, independent reconstruction, post-seal primary-source correspondence, and explicit boundaries separating observation, inference, aggregation, power, norm, value and scientific admission.
title: From One Relation to Society: An Exact, Zero-Parameter and Machine-Closed Foundational Reconstruction of Social and Collective Sciences from Smithian Fold Theory
